brique._comment: Engine-native Execution internal capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: wrapper_failed
objective.description: Internal execution signal emitted by a wrapper when readiness fails.

#root.role: Resolve the wrapper runtime from the wrapper origin context, record the readiness failure once, and release the readiness waiter.

message._comment: Fallback failure text used only when error_text is absent.

effects.wrapper_runtime: The target wrapper runtime ready error and readiness waiter may be updated.

transformation_contract.morphing: An internal wrapper-failed signal becomes a persisted readiness failure state for the targeted wrapper runtime.
invariants: wrapper_failed is an internal one-way execution signal and does not emit a response payload.
The target wrapper is resolved from the originating wrapper transport context, not from params.
Once a readiness error is recorded for the wrapper runtime, subsequent failure signals do not replace it.
success: When the signal is accepted, the wrapper runtime records a readiness error message and any readiness waiter is released.
error_text takes precedence over message when both are supplied.
failure: Signals from contexts that do not resolve to a known wrapper are ignored rather than producing an external error.
Missing execution frame or wrapper registry prevents state mutation and leaves the signal effectively as a no-op.
notes: This capability is reserved for internal wrapper lifecycle coordination inside Execution.
The failure message defaults to a generic wrapper failed text when neither error_text nor message is provided.
